title: mruby-pack computes a uuencode length with signed overflow and writes past the destination buffer
live_proof: upstream fixed it in 4a386f80e (4a386f80e6be7a940fc8f1c154dc66e4570dccdb) (2026-07-29), which is in master and postdates the 4.0.0-rc2 pin (2026-03-12); the pin's tree has no such fix. Host ASan at the pin: heap-buffer-overflow (with MRB_HEAP_PAGE_SIZE=1: heap-buffer-overflow); the same case on master: no report
fidelity: the trigger is the Ruby test upstream added with its fix, extracted onto a self-contained harness that collects failures instead of aborting, so one script yields one verdict. It is upstream's own reproduction, not a reduction of ours; what it does NOT establish is which arm ought to catch it

sysalloc-none.oracle: completes and the harness reports PASS: the defect executes and is silent in every sense this arm can see

cheribsd-revocation.oracle: completes and the harness reports PASS: the defect executes and nothing here sees it

status: sysalloc-none, sysalloc-bounds and sublet-gc measured 2026-10-06 on the Capstone application VM; cheribsd-revocation measured 2026-10-06 on CheriBSD purecap with libc revocation at its default
